faq.q: How do I install FC Mobile on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for FC Mobile and check the developer is ELECTRONIC ARTS before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from ELECTRONIC ARTS and may be altered, so the safest way to play FC Mobile is the official listing.

faq.q: Is EA SPORTS FC Mobile free?
faq.a: Yes. FC Mobile is free to download and play. Google Play marks it as containing ads and lists in-app purchases from $0.39 to $99.99 per item, mainly FC Points and passes. You can build a strong team without paying by playing events and using the market.

The FC Mobile 27 season adds Game Plans for changing formation and mentality mid-match, new PlayStyles such as Incisive Pass and Dead Ball, Gauntlet Mode with unique Traits and House Rules, plus updated visuals, commentary and celebrations.

faq.q: Is FC Mobile the same as FIFA Mobile?
faq.a: Yes. EA's football games were renamed from FIFA to EA SPORTS FC in 2023, when EA's licence deal with FIFA ended. FC Mobile is the continuation of FIFA Mobile, on the same Google Play listing.

faq.q: Does FC Mobile need an internet connection?
faq.a: Yes. FC Mobile needs an internet connection to play, because your team, market and events are all online.
